title: New Congruences Involving $p$-adic dual sequences
summary: Let $(a_n)_{n\geqslant 0}$ be a sequence of integers. Its dual sequence $(a_n^*)_{n\geqslant 0}$ is defined by \begin{equation*} a_n^* := \sum_{k=0}^{n} \binom{n}{k}(-1)^k a_k. \end{equation*} Let $p>3$ be a prime. In this paper we mainly investigate congruences modulo $p^2$ involving central binomial coefficients and $p$-adic dual sequences. For example, we prove that for any sequence $(a_k)_{k\ge0}$ of $p$-adic integers, \begin{align*} \sum^{(p-1)/2}_{k=0}\binom{2k}{k}^2\frac{a_{2k}}{16^k}\equiv\left( \frac{-1}{p}\right) \sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\mathcal{P}_{k}}{16 ^{k}}a_{k}^*\pmod{p^2},…
